Record Class PlanetPreset

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.ether.society.procedural.PlanetPreset
Record Components:
name - Name of the preset (e.g., "Earth-Like")
resolution - H3 resolution (e.g., 6, 7, 8)
seed - Random seed
noiseFrequency - Base frequency of the noise (terrain detail)
noiseScale - Vertical scale of the noise (elevation range)
waterLevel - Elevation threshold for ocean (0.0 to 1.0)
temperatureGradient - Temperature difference between equator and poles
public record PlanetPreset(String name, int resolution, long seed, double noiseFrequency, double noiseScale, double waterLevel, double temperatureGradient) extends Record
Configuration preset for procedural planet generation.

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
      Specified by:

      Parameters:
